activity.notes: Ramón Freire served as President of Chile from 25 January to 8 May 1827. ATLAS records this separately from his earlier Supreme Directorship because these were distinct constitutional offices.

sources.title: Reseña Biográfica Ramón Freire Serrano — Biblioteca del Congreso Nacional de Chile
sources.citation_text: The Chilean Library of Congress records Ramón Freire as President of the Republic from 25 January 1827 to 8 May 1827.
